\[
f(x_1,\ldots,x_m)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,m\}}a_S\prod_{i\in S}x_i,
\qquad a_S\in\mathbb F_2,
\]

\[
\operatorname{wt}(f)=\bigl|\{x\in\mathbb F_2^m:f(x)=1\}\bigr|,
\]

\[
\mathcal W_m=\{\operatorname{wt}(f):f\in\mathrm{RM}(m-7,m)\}

\[
[L,U]_2=\{L,L+2,\ldots,U\},
\]

random.seed(5678)
ALL=(1<<16384)-1
V=[sum(1<<x for x in range(16384) if x>>j&1) for j in range(14)]
def make(q):
 b=ALL
 for j,v in q:b&= V[j] if v else ALL^V[j]
 return b
def mutate(q):
 q=list(q);p=random.randrange(7)
 if random.random()<.1:q[p]=(q[p][0],1-q[p][1])
 else:
  used={j for j,v in q};j=random.choice(list(set(range(14))-used));q[p]=(j,0)
 return tuple(sorted(q))
